description: MainActivity.java is an Android Java source file that demonstrates how to access SMS messages, check and set the app as the default SMS app, and interact with the SMS content provider. It handles UI components, incoming intents, and loader callbacks for querying SMS inbox messages.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that manages SMS viewing and sending, default SMS app role, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up loader for SMS data, and processes incoming intents.

methods.name: sendSms
methods.description: Placeholder method to send SMS messages if the app is default SMS app.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks and updates UI based on whether the app is the default SMS app and attempts to retrieve the phone number.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader to query SMS messages from the inbox.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of SMS query loader, updating the UI cursor.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the cursor when loader is reset.
